minereum public state variable holding the payment token/contract address;
address allowed to reload external contracts and fee, initialized to zero;
mapping(address=>bool) tracking addresses that listed their level1 ownership for sale;
mapping(address=>uint256) storing the wei sale price per seller;
mapping(address=>bool) audit flag set when an address lists for sale;

uint fee percentage (default 20) added on top of the sale price;
uint counter of completed ownership sales;
uint counter of set-for-sale operations;
uint counter of remove-from-sale operations;

public function that, only when called by updaterAddress, rebinds the genesisCalls contract;
public function that, only when called by updaterAddress, updates the fee percentage;
public function that one-time sets updaterAddress to msg.sender while it is still zero;
constructor wiring external1, genesisCalls and the fixed minereum address, and calling setUpdater;
lists the caller's level1 ownership for sale after validating genesis level1 status and price;

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to the zero address and used to claim updater ownership in setUpdater.
msg.sender must equal updaterAddress to execute reloadExternal1.
msg.sender must equal updaterAddress to execute reloadGenesis.
msg.sender must equal updaterAddress to execute reloadFee.
msg.sender is the listing key and is checked as a genesis level1 address.
msg.sender determines whose listing is removed in removeLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale.
msg.sender is the buyer, becomes the genesis owner and pays msg.value in BuyLevel1Ownership.
reloadExternal1 reassigns the ext1 state variable.
reloadGenesis reassigns the gn state variable.
reloadFee writes the new value into the fee state variable.
setUpdater writes msg.sender into updaterAddress.
the constructor calls setUpdater internally.
the constructor assigns the external1 reference into ext1.
the constructor assigns the genesisCalls reference into gn.
the constructor assigns a fixed minereum address into mneAddress.
setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale sets the caller's listing flag to true.
setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale stores the requested wei price for the caller.
setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale increments countSetForSale.
setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale sets wasEverSetForSale for the caller.
setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale calls gn.isGenesisAddressLevel1 to authorize the caller.
removeLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale clears the caller's listing flag.
removeLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale zeroes the caller's sale price.
removeLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale increments countRemoveForSale.
removeLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale sets wasEverRemovedForSale for the caller.
getIsLevel1SetForOwnershipSale reads the listing mapping.
getLevel1OwnershipSalePrice reads the stored sale price mapping.
getLevel1OwnershipSalePriceWithFee reads the sale price of the queried address.
getLevel1OwnershipSalePriceWithFee reads the fee state variable.
the sale price and fee feed the multiplication/division computing the fee amount.
BuyLevel1Ownership reads and then clears the seller's listing flag.
BuyLevel1Ownership reads and then zeroes the seller's sale price.
BuyLevel1Ownership calls getLevel1OwnershipSalePriceWithFee to validate msg.value.
BuyLevel1Ownership performs an external payable Payment call into mneAddress before state updates.
BuyLevel1Ownership invokes a low-level ether send to the seller while listing state is still set.
BuyLevel1Ownership calls ext1.TransferGenesis externally to move genesis ownership.
BuyLevel1Ownership increments countSales on a successful purchase.
the low-level send transfers control to the seller before isLevel1SetForOwnershipSale and the sale price are cleared, allowing reentry into BuyLevel1Ownership.
reloadExternal1 uses the _address argument as the new ext1 contract.
the _address argument is cast and assigned into the ext1 state variable.
reloadGenesis uses the _address argument as the new genesisCalls contract.
the _address argument is cast and assigned into the gn state variable.
reloadFee uses the _fee argument as the new fee value.
the _fee argument is written into the fee state variable.
the constructor parameter _genesisCallsAddress is consumed during contract setup.
_genesisCallsAddress is assigned into the gn state variable.
the constructor parameter _external1Address is consumed during contract setup.
_external1Address is assigned into the ext1 state variable.
weiPrice is validated against zero inside setLevel1AddressForOwnershipSale.
weiPrice is stored into level1OwnewshipSalePrice for the caller.
_address is used to index the listing mapping in the view getter.
_address is used to index the sale price mapping in the view getter.
_address is used to read the sale price before adding the fee.
_seller drives the listing lookups, payment amount and ownership transfer in BuyLevel1Ownership.
the caller-supplied _seller address is the recipient of the low-level send, enabling reentrant callbacks.
feeAmount is the local result computed inside getLevel1OwnershipSalePriceWithFee.
feeAmount is produced by the sale-price-times-fee division arithmetic.
